column1: # Upstream kernel mailing-list submissions relevant to the Surface Pro 9, harvested from patchwork.kernel.org REST API
# (projects platform-driver-x86, linux-input, linux-media, linux-pm, linux-acpi, linux-pci, alsa-devel, linux-usb, bluetooth,
# linux-wireless), subject searches since 2021-06, on 2026-11-12. lore.kernel.org itself is behind a bot challenge, so open
# threads with https://lore.kernel.org/r/<msgid> in a normal browser.
# Rechecked 2026-11-14 by msgid for every row since 2026-07: no state changed. New since 2026-11-11: only the row for Antoine Pichot below.
# state = patchwork state(s) across versions (new, changes-requested, accepted, handled-elsewhere, superseded, mainlined, ...).
# n = patches seen in the group (all versions). sp9 = relevance for SP9 (direct, sibling, generic, none).
